summary_en: 1,599,686 shares tendered (45.7% ex-treasury); ¥5,200/share; ¥8,318M aggregate consideration. Tender offer closed 8 July 2026. Mitsuba (80%) and Chubu Electric (20%) each to acquire pro-rata. Minimum acceptance threshold of 537,260 shares satisfied.
title_en: Notice of Tender Offer Results for Ryomou Systems Inc. (Ticker: 9691)
translation_en_brief: Mitsuba Corporation and Chubu Electric Power Company jointly announced the completion of a public tender offer for Ryomou Systems Inc. (TYO Standard Market, 9691), which closed on 8 July 2026 after a 39-business-day offer period (15 May – 8 July). The bidders offered ¥5,200 per common share. The tender resulted in 1,599,686 shares tendered, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 537,260 shares. Mitsuba will acquire approximately 1,003,800 shares (80% of total acquired shares) and Chubu Electric will acquire the remainder (20%), reflecting their stated intent to achieve voting control at approximately 80% and 20% respectively in the target. The aggregate consideration is ¥8,318 million. As of 31 March 2026 (per the target's earnings release of 14 May 2026), the target had 3,510,000 shares issued with 11,513 held in treasury; Mitsuba held 1,795,040 shares as of 14 May 2026, leaving a maximum acquisition target of 1,703,447 shares. The actual 1,599,686 tendered represents 45.7% of the 3,498,487 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
